import bpy,bmesh,json
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['work15'];cap=ns['cap'];craft=ns['craft'];hash_object=ns['object_hash']
checks=[]
def ck(name,value):
 assert value,name
 checks.append(name)
ck('Surface and roof changes saved',craft.get('work15_surfaces') and craft.get('work15_roof'))
preserve=json.loads((cap/'preserve_geometry_before.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
changed=[n for n,h in preserve.items() if n not in craft.objects or hash_object(craft.objects[n])!=h]
ck('Boat, stonework, ground, main roof and walls retained',not changed)
ck('Five thin cap sheets',sum(o.get('work15_sheet',False) for o in craft.objects)==5)
ck('Eight slim kerbs',sum(o.get('work15_slim_curb',False) for o in craft.objects)==8)
ck('Six T section glazing bars',sum(o.name.startswith(('W15 glazing tee','W15 glazing cross tee')) for o in craft.objects)==6)
ck('Two roof lights retained',sum(o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B inset skylight glazing') for o in craft.objects)==2)
deps=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get();bad=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 if not (o.get('work15_sheet') or o.get('work15_closed')):continue
 ev=o.evaluated_get(deps);me=ev.to_mesh();bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(me)
 invalid=sum(not e.is_manifold for e in bm.edges);vol=bm.calc_volume(signed=True);bm.free();ev.to_mesh_clear()
 if invalid or vol<=0:bad.append([o.name,invalid,vol])
ck('New roof parts closed and outward facing',not bad)
ck('Source saved',not bpy.data.is_dirty)
result={'checks':checks,'preserved_geometry_objects':len(preserve),'changed_preserved_objects':changed,'invalid_new_roof_meshes':bad,'editable_objects':len(craft.objects)}
(cap/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('W15_SOURCE',len(checks),'passed',result)
